content: Android emulator automation: adb uiautomator dump + input tap/type are stock; adb screencap SLOW (~2.1s median at 1440x3120, Android 15 emulator, handsets blog May 2026). Faster capture: raw framebuffer streams (scrcpy-style) or minicap. Community wrappers (adb-android-interact, agent-android) exist for agent driving.
